refnamediv.refpurpose: announce the system's clock through TAICLOCK

refsection.title: Description
refsection.para: taiclock4d is identical to taiclockd1 except that it expects a UDP/IPv4 socket or an IPv4 adddress in the IP environment variable. taiclockd1 is capable of handling both IPv4 and IPv6 requests on combined-stack systems, and it is not necessary to use taiclock4d on such systems.
refsection.title: History
refsection.para: taiclockd was originally part of Daniel J. Bernstein's clockspeed toolset in 1998.

refsection.title: Author
refsection.para: Original code and documentation by Daniel J. Bernstein. Documentation modernizations by Jonathan de Boyne Pollard.
